title: A Lost Packet on a Mobile Connection
description: A mobile client has several HTTP/2 streams on one TCP connection. Packet loss stalls otherwise independent responses. Which HTTP/3 property helps with this?

options.text: It removes encryption so packets arrive sooner.
options.explanation: HTTP/3 uses QUIC with TLS; removing encryption is not its latency mechanism.

options.text: Its QUIC streams recover independently from packet loss.
options.explanation: QUIC avoids TCP's cross-stream head-of-line blocking. A missing packet can still delay its own stream, and congestion control remains shared.

options.text: It guarantees no packets are lost over UDP.
options.explanation: UDP does not prevent loss. QUIC supplies transport reliability and stream recovery above it.

options.text: It requires a fresh TCP connection for every response.
options.explanation: HTTP/3 uses QUIC over UDP, not per-response TCP connections.
